dedupe_keys.name: rgna active national geodetic network of mexico rinex files inegi

description: The Red Geodésica Nacional Activa (RGNA) is the network of fixed GNSS stations of INEGI, the Mexican national statistics and geography institute, which forms the active part of the national geodetic framework. Its download page lets users choose a station and a start and end date and time and download RINEX files in version 2.11 or 3.04, and it notes that surveys can be tied to other stations with dual-frequency equipment when one station has no data. The page also gives a new SFTP server for bulk downloads after a service migration (the old FTP server closing on 1 July 2026), a notice on the 2021 renewal of the network's GNSS equipment, a note on the displacement of station COL2 caused by the earthquake of 19 September 2022, and usage requirements for the RINEX files; station ICMX in Mexico City is unavailable because of interference. Access is free online; no licence is stated on the page read, which links the usage specifications. Caveats: some stations have gaps or are out of service, and the page is in Spanish. Coverage is Mexico. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, crustal deformation after earthquakes and space weather effects on GNSS; related records are ReNEP of Portugal and the Spanish ERGNSS network.
